يستعطفوا (form X)
# يَسْتَعْطِفُوا (yastaʕṭifū) /jas.taʕ.tˤi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# يُسْتَعْطَفُوا (yustaʕṭafū) /jus.taʕ.tˤa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
